title: Magnification and Unit Conversions
opener_concept: A photographer enlarges a bee: the print bee (12 cm) is 6x the real bee (2 cm), so 6 IS the magnification (image/actual). A second box makes the student give 1000 as the mm-to-um factor, teaching the convert-then-divide habit that is the whole lesson.
